title: Tunisian Egg Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make egg wrap inspired by Tunisian cuisine. This recipe combines the creaminess of oozy cheese with the savory taste of egg and wrap.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them until they are cooked through.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Add the cooked eggs to the center of the wrap.
Sprinkle the oozy, creamy cheese on top of the eggs.
Dust the tunisian spice blend over the cheese.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides.
